cta.title: Ready to take action?
cta.description: Join the KRAAK ecosystem and take your ambitions further.
cta.label: Contact us

brand.description: Operational excellence in service of human development. Strategic expertise in Africa and international support.

hero.description: KRAAK Consulting supports students, professionals, businesses and members of the diaspora with practical solutions in training, project management and immigration.

need.title: An offer structured around employability, projects and mobility.
need.description: We step in where progress stalls: clarifying goals, strengthening application tools, structuring projects, recruiting, planning international mobility and defining the next useful step.

training.imageAlt: Participants attending a professional development session in a collaborative workshop
training.caption: Employability, professional confidence and language development.

projects.imageAlt: A team meeting around a table to scope a project
projects.caption: Scoping, structuring and supporting projects that matter.

mobility.imageAlt: An advisory meeting with documents to prepare an international mobility plan
mobility.caption: Methodical preparation for study, work and international mobility.

training.title: Training
training.description: For young people and professionals who want to strengthen their employability, professional presence and application toolkit.

projects.title: Research & Project Management
projects.description: For start-ups, businesses and project leaders who need to scope, plan and move a worthwhile initiative forward.

mobility.title: Study & Immigration
mobility.description: For people pursuing study, work or international mobility with clear, step-by-step preparation.

solutions.title: Practical starting points for your goals.
solutions.description: You do not need a perfectly defined brief: we start with a concrete goal, then clarify the right form of support.

proof.title: Support grounded in real needs.
proof.description: KRAAK works within a clear framework: a careful understanding of needs, practical formats and a focus on meaningful impact for individuals and organisations alike.

socioeconomicIntegration.title: Employability and career integration
socioeconomicIntegration.description: Young people's employability remains at the heart of our offer: guidance, application tools, interviews, professional confidence and tangible progress towards employment.

twoWayApproach.title: A two-way approach
twoWayApproach.description: We support both talent and organisations to narrow the gap between market needs, available skills and expected performance.

internationalExperience.title: International experience
internationalExperience.description: Our work and field experience draw on assignments in Canada, the United States, Spain, France, Colombia, Cuba, Ghana, Cameroon, Togo and Côte d'Ivoire.

structuredSupport.title: Structured support
structuredSupport.description: Every engagement connects a clear understanding of the need with the next step, an action plan and follow-up. Our aim is not to multiply promises, but to make the path ahead clearer.

whyChoose.title: Why choose KRAAK?
whyChoose.description: Rigorous, practical support grounded in your real goals.

internationalExpertise.title: Internationally recognised expertise
internationalExpertise.description: Expertise applied across several settings to meet both local and international needs.

personalisedSupport.title: Personalised support
personalisedSupport.description: Every profile is unique, so we adapt the framework, pace and deliverables to the real context.

measurableResults.title: Tangible, measurable results
measurableResults.description: Our approach connects every action to an observable and useful next step.

faq.title: Clarify your starting point before you begin.
faq.description: This initial selection of questions will help you identify the right service and the most useful next step for your needs.
faq.backgroundAlt: A KRAAK adviser guiding a participant through her options
faq.panelDescription: Review the answers to our most frequently asked questions before telling us about your needs.

gettingStarted.question: I am not sure where to start. What is the first step?
gettingStarted.answer: Start by sharing your goal, context and timeframe through the contact form. We will then guide you to the right starting point.

businessSupport.question: Do you offer support for businesses?
businessSupport.answer: Yes. KRAAK also supports organisations with project management, staff training, recruitment and team performance.

consultationFormat.question: Are consultations available in person or remotely?
consultationFormat.answer: Consultations can take place remotely or in person, depending on your needs, the service and the project's constraints.

closing.titleLine1: You know where you want to go.
closing.titleLine2: We know how to help you get there.

hero.description: Would you like to take a course, structure a project, prepare for international mobility or discuss a partnership? The KRAAK team is here to guide you towards the support that best fits your needs.

details.imageAlt: A guidance meeting to clarify support needs
details.heading: Give us the right information to guide you.
details.description: Training, projects, leadership and international mobility: tell us your priority and we will come back to you with a clear action plan.
